Mean pairwise cosine near zero does not exclude dimensional collapse: balanced vectors along ±one direction can average near zero while spanning rank one. Dimensional collapse concerns restricted subspace occupancy, distinguishable from constant representations ([Jing et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.09348)). Affordable diagnostics: sample nonpadding item embeddings and final history features separately; measure centered singular-value spectra, total variance, leading-component variance share, and effective rank. Specify the definition: RankMe uses normalized singular values, whereas covariance effective rank uses normalized squared singular values ([RankMe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.02885)). Report norm quantiles and cosine distributions too. Low rank alone does not establish harmful collapse; relate it to validation discrimination.

Separate representation geometry from score scale. Measure history/item norms, candidate-logit standard deviation, positive-minus-hardest-negative margin, and positive-minus-tenth-negative margin. Compare raw dot-product and normalized angular separation diagnostically. Small margins can reflect poor discrimination or small norms; large norms do not demonstrate useful representations. Reliability plots, NLL and Brier score assess probability calibration under the fixed sampled-candidate protocol, not full-catalog probabilities. Positive temperature scaling preserves ranking, so calibration alone cannot improve HR@10 ([Guo et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.04599)).

Recency research motivates distinguishing older from recent interactions ([Petrov and Macdonald](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.02643)). Proposed mechanism tests: freeze the model; retain identical validation users, targets and candidates; compare recent-k-only histories, removal of equally sized old versus recent blocks, and shuffling within each block. Preserve the final item when testing earlier-order dependence; use length-matched replacement controls to separate content from padding effects. Record paired changes in HR@10, margins and feature distance with uncertainty. Respect left padding and final-nonpadding readout. These interventions measure model dependence, not causal effects on user behavior; NextItNet’s receptive field bounds detectable older-history influence.
